name: Khalifa
source:
"The scorching sun will illuminate our future...!"

Nationality: Tefnut
Role: Sultan
Ability: Sand manipulation

Khalifa embodies the essence of Tefnut in its boldest form: radiant, proud, and unapologetically indulgent. To her, the world’s treasures—gold, jewels, even people—are hers by nature. Humility doesn’t exist in her vocabulary.

She is the kind of woman who flaunts what others would hide, and gives away what others would hoard. Her insatiable urge to collect knows no bounds, living beings included.

Some call her arrogant. Others, reckless. And yet, despite her extravagance, she is adored by the masses—thanks in no small part to her staggering philanthropy (and, let’s be honest, her beauty).

During a diplomatic visit to the Land of Solar, Khalifa caught sight of Haesu… and smiled.

Some say it was curiosity. Others say it was the look of a collector who’s just found her next prize.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
